about.title: Built on skill, and on iron sharpening iron
text: Texas Welding Company has been a reliable source for Waco's welding since 2017, and we are locally owned near I-35, between Dallas and Austin.

We work with contractors and construction management companies, and we aim to save a project the time and money lost on uncertain subcontractor relationships by meeting its welding needs under one roof.
We are a Christ-based company, grounded in the principle "As iron sharpens iron, so one person sharpens another."
